desc: The LWRCI Rapid Engagement Precision Rifle is a full-spectrum weapon system designed to put devastating 6.5 Creedmoor rounds on target in a variety of real world applications. LWRCI's build for the US Military CSASS Solicitation Program is at the heart of the REPR MKII design. Starting with the patented LWRCI short-stroke gas piston operating system the REPR MKII offers unparalleled reliability, easy maintenance and optimal accuracy. The LWRCI proprietary 20 - position tunable gas block allows the shooter or operator ultimate control to meet the demands of any condition. The REPR MKII 6.5 Creedmoor improves upon the dependability, accuracy, and aesthetics that made the original REPR a major success. Our REPR MKII 6.5 Creedmoor model is built for high performance and comes fully loaded with custom rifle extras like a 22" Black Nitride treated LWRCI heavy barrel, Monoforge upper receiver with integrated rail base, Geissele SSA-E 2-stage Precision Trigger, Magpul PRS adjustable premium stock, all new LWRCI Ultra Brake 4 Port Enhanced muzzle brake, meaning you'll get the best performance possible straight out of the box. Add in the LWRCI standard feautes - fully ambidextrous lower receiver controls- bolt catch and release, magazine release and safety selector, ambidextrous rear charging handle, LWRCI Skirmish BUIS and Advanced Trigger Guard- and it is easy to see why this new REPR MKII 6.5 Creedmoor is clearly a Step Up!
